title: Accounts Assistant (Part-time 30 hrs)
description:
As a part-time Accounts Assistant in Edinburgh within the leisure, travel and tourism industry, you'll play a key role in keeping the financial side of things running smoothly. From handling invoices to maintaining accurate records, your day-to-day tasks will help ensure everything adds up just as it should.

Client Details

An organisation based in Edinburgh, working within the leisure, travel and tourism industry.

Description
- Process and manage invoices, ensuring accuracy and timely payments.
- Assist with bank reconciliations and financial record-keeping.
- Support the preparation of financial reports and statements.
- Maintain accurate financial data in accounting systems.
- Help monitor budgets and track expenses.
- Provide support during audits and other financial reviews.
- Communicate effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders regarding financial queries.
- Assist with general administrative duties within the accounting and finance department.

Profile

A successful Accounts Assistant should have:
- Previous experience in an accounting or finance role.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy in financial tasks.
- Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks.
- Clear and confident communication skills.

Job Offer
- A permanent part-time role of 30 hours per week.
- Salary dependent on the level of experience, ranging from 20,250 to 24,000.
- Contract benefits.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. title: Business Coordinator
description:
Business Coordinator

Central Edinburgh £28,500 £30,000 per annum Full Time Permanent 40 hours per week

About the Role

Our client is an established care and support organisation that has specialised in providing high-quality support and care staff to voluntary and statutory projects across Central Scotland for more than 20 years.

They are now looking for a Business Coordinator to join their busy and growing team in Central Edinburgh.

This is a varied, people-focused role combining client relationship management, business development and staffing coordination. You will build strong relationships with existing clients, reconnect with previous clients, identify new opportunities and make sure staffing requirements are responded to quickly and effectively.

You'll work closely with clients, agency staff, managers and colleagues, coordinating shifts and matching suitable staff to client requirements. It's an opportunity for someone who enjoys making things happen, building relationships and keeping multiple moving parts organised.

What you'll be responsible for:
- Building and maintaining strong relationships with existing clients.
- Reconnecting with previous and inactive clients and developing new business opportunities.
- Understanding clients' staffing needs and identifying opportunities to provide additional support.
- Responding promptly to client enquiries and following up opportunities.
- Coordinating agency, SDS1 and care and support shifts and responding to staffing gaps.
- Matching suitable staff to shifts based on availability, experience, training and client requirements.
- Managing shift changes, cancellations and replacement cover.
- Maintaining accurate client, staffing and business development records.
- Supporting the Agency Manager with the smooth running and continued development of the Agency.
- Helping to improve systems and processes around staffing and shift coordination.
- Participating in the organisation's on-call rota.

About You

You'll be organised, proactive and confident in building relationships, with the ability to work effectively in a busy environment where priorities can change quickly.

You'll be someone who:
- Communicates professionally and naturally with clients, staff and colleagues.
- Is responsive and comfortable working in a busy environment where priorities can change quickly.
- Has excellent admin, organisational and coordination skills.
- Can identify opportunities and take initiative rather than waiting to be asked.
- Is confident dealing with staffing issues and finding practical solutions.
- Can manage competing priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
- Works well as part of a team and is happy to support colleagues when needed.
- Has a positive, professional and approachable manner.

Previous experience in business development, client relationship management, recruitment, staffing coordination or a care / support environment would be advantageous.

Why Consider This Opportunity

This is an opportunity to join a growing organisation in a position where your relationships, organisation and ability to make things happen will have a direct impact on clients, staff and the continued development of the services delivered.

You'll work closely with Senior Management and a wider team, with the opportunity to contribute ideas, develop relationships and help shape how staffing services are delivered.

Location: Central Edinburgh

Hours: 40 hours per week

Contract: Full-time, Permanent

Salary: £28,500 £30,000 per annum

If this sounds like the opportunity you're looking for, our client would like to hear from you.

As part of your application, you'll complete a short online recruitment process taking approximately 10 minutes. It's designed to help you and our client understand whether the role is a strong mutual fit before progressing to the next stage.

- Handing requests for information or changes to details quickly and securely

title: Temporary HR Administrator
description:
Temporary HR Administrator
Location: Edinburgh or Glasgow
Contract: 3-month Fixed-Term Contract
Hours: Full-time, Monday to Friday
Pay: 13.70 per hour
Are you an organised Administrator with a sharp eye for detail and a methodical approach to your work?
We are looking for a Temporary HR Data Administrator to join an established HR team for a 3-month project. The role will focus on reviewing, validating and updating employee information within the organisation's HR system, ensuring records are accurate, complete and consistently maintained.
This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data, systems and processes and takes pride in getting the detail right.
You do not need previous experience of SelectHR. Experience using HR, payroll, recruitment, database or other business systems will be considered.
Working as part of the HR team, you will provide administrative support throughout a focused data validation and system improvement project.
Your responsibilities will include:
- Reviewing existing employee records and checking information for accuracy and completeness.
- Inputting and updating personnel information accurately and consistently.
- Validating HR data against source documentation and agreed criteria.
- Identifying missing information, discrepancies, duplicate records or other anomalies.
- Investigating information where required and raising queries with the wider HR team.
- Ensuring any agreed amendments are accurately reflected within the HR system.
- Supporting the review of HR system screens, fields and data requirements.
- Identifying opportunities to improve the consistency and usability of HR data.
- Maintaining accurate records of information reviewed and any issues identified.
- Working systematically through allocated records and meeting agreed deadlines.
- Using Excel and other systems to review, organise and manage information.
- Handling confidential employee information appropriately at all times.
- Following internal processes and data protection requirements when accessing and updating personnel information.
- Providing general administrative support to the HR team where required during the project.

You will be a highly organised and detail-focused Administrator who is comfortable working with systems and large amounts of information.
We are particularly interested in people who can demonstrate:
- Previous experience in an administrative, HR, payroll, recruitment, people services, data or similar role.
- Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to completing work.
- Experience inputting, checking, maintaining or validating data.
- Confidence working with computerised systems and databases.
